specs.title: TC-01: the Tuesday 09:00 UTC run settles Mon 02 Nov 00:00 to Mon 09 Nov 00:00 UTC and pays the task inside it
TC-02: a run at Tue 08:59:59 UTC settles the previous week, paying a 30 Oct task and leaving a 4 Nov task
TC-03: happy path pays 10 credits per completed task and notifies each account once with its total
TC-04: a task at exactly Monday 00:00 (start) and one at the last millisecond are paid; one at the next Monday 00:00 is not
TC-05: +05:00 timestamps are converted to UTC, so only the one at Sun 08 Nov 23:59 UTC is paid
TC-06: in-progress and cancelled tasks earn nothing, create no ledger entry and trigger no notification
TC-07: the same task ID twice in one export is paid once: one ledger entry, 10 credits, the duplicate row skipped
